name: For the Better, Right?
look: Four panels in a 2x2 grid set in a sunny meadow. Top left: Anakin Skywalker, with short hair and a thin braid, says something with a smug look. Top right: Padmé, in a flowered headband, smiles broadly. Bottom left: Anakin stares back in silence. Bottom right: Padmé's smile fades into a worried look.
use: Anakin announces a plan, Padmé smiles and asks a hopeful follow-up that assumes the good outcome, Anakin just stares, and Padmé repeats the question with dawning worry. His silence confirms the bad outcome.
slots: Padmé repeating the question, now worried (bottom right)
examples: I'm rewriting the whole app this weekend
I signed us up for a 5K
describe: anakin says something and padme smiles then looks worried
star wars couple in a field she asks and he stares silently
four panels guy announces plan girl smiles then realizes
woman's smile fades when the man doesn't answer her question
padme happy then nervous after anakin goes quiet
origin: From the 2002 film Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones, during Anakin and Padmé's conversation in a meadow on Naboo.
